//: Safety net for tools that run node/npm/npx inside release/app while the calling shell exports NODE_OPTIONS="-r ts-node/register ..." and TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.node.json (see package.json build scripts). ts-node resolves TS_NODE_PROJECT relative to the cwd, so without this file every node process started here fails with "TS5083: Cannot read file '.../release/app/tsconfig.node.json'. Keeping this file makes such processes start normally instead of printing ts-node errors into the output (electron-builder parses `npm ls --json` output and errors out when it is not JSON).
